title: Liability Allocation
description: Current breakdown of how liability is allocated for the disputed amount

recovered_amount.description: The amount that has been recovered from the merchant through the dispute process

written_off_amount.description: The amount the issuer has chosen to write off

denied_amount.description: The amount that has been denied to the cardholder

remaining_amount.description: Any disputed amount that is still outstanding, i.e. has not been recovered, written off, or denied
